definitions.title: Pay {creditor} down to {target}
definitions.detail: You do not have to do it in one payment. Anything you put against this card moves the balance toward the target.

definitions.title: Print and mail your dispute letters
definitions.detail: Print the letters from your pack, sign where marked, and mail a copy to each bureau address in the instructions. Keep your post office receipt.

definitions.title: Upload your mailing proof
definitions.detail: Take a clear photo of your post office receipt or the stamped envelopes. Upload it here when you are done.

definitions.title: Upload bureau responses when they arrive
definitions.detail: When a bureau writes back, photograph or scan the letter and upload it here.

definitions.title: Do not open new credit while we work on your file
definitions.detail: A new card adds a hard inquiry and lowers the average age of your accounts. Talk to our team before you apply for anything.

definitions.title: Talk to our team about a personal loan
definitions.detail: Raise it early, before any of the optimization work changes your accounts. Our team will walk you through whether it fits your plan.

definitions.title: File your LLC
definitions.detail: File online with the Secretary of State{state_clause}. Send us the filing confirmation once you have it.

definitions.title: Get your EIN from the IRS
definitions.detail: You can apply for one on IRS.gov at no cost. Your business bank account will ask for it.

definitions.title: Open a business checking account
definitions.detail: Open it in the LLC name, using the EIN. Take your filing paperwork and your EIN letter with you.
